svg.aria-label: Share of India's international sector passengers by carrier home region, 2015 to 2025, with 2020 and 2021 omitted because repatriation flying distorts them. Indian carriers rose from 37.0% to 45.9%, a gain of 8.9 points, while Gulf carriers fell from 32.7% to 26.2%, giving up 6.6 points.
svg.desc: Source: DGCA traffic statistics, pulled 2026-08-15. Computed in-repo, not quoted.
